name: archscript_guide
title: ArchScript language guide
description: The ArchScript language: syntax, element types, containers (domain, boundary, environment, cluster, server, container), relations, properties, rules, custom types and the edit operations. Read this before writing ArchScript.

name: list_documents
title: List open documents
description: Open ArchScript documents with id, file name, project name, validity and size. The first entry is the frontmost window.

name: get_document
title: Read a document
description: Source code (with line numbers), diagnostics, metrics and the structure (containers, elements, relations with their indices) of a document.

document.description: Document id (e.g. doc1), file name or project name. Omit for the frontmost document.

name: create_document
title: Create a document
description: Opens a new ArchScript window with the given source and returns its id and diagnostics.

name: set_document_source
title: Replace a document's source
description: Replaces the whole source of a document (one undoable step in the user's window). Returns diagnostics.

document.description: Document id (e.g. doc1), file name or project name. Omit for the frontmost document.

name: edit_document
title: Edit a document
description:
Applies structured edit operations in order (one undoable step). Each operation is an object with "op" and its fields:
add_element {kind, name, container?} · add_relation {from, to, label?, bidirectional?} · set_property {element, key, value|null} · rename {element, name} · change_id {element, id} · change_kind {element, kind} · set_tags {element, tags[]} · move_to_container {element, container|null} · delete_element {element} · set_relation_label {relation, label|null} · set_relation_property {relation, key, value|null} · set_relation_direction {relation, direction: forward|reverse|both} · delete_relation {relation} · add_container {kind, name, container?} · rename_container {container, name} · delete_container {container} (keeps contents) · set_container_property {container, key, value|null} · set_container_color {container, color|null}.
Elements are referenced by id, relations by index (see get_document), containers by key like "cluster:Prod/server:app-01".

document.description: Document id (e.g. doc1), file name or project name. Omit for the frontmost document.

name: validate
title: Validate source
description: Compiles ArchScript source without opening or changing a document: diagnostics, metrics and review score.

name: review
title: Architecture review
description: Score, grade, metadata coverage, coupling and all rule findings of a document.

name: render_diagram
title: Render the diagram
description: The document's diagram as a PNG image (the last valid state).

name: export
title: Export
description: Generated output of a valid document: mermaid, plantuml, markdown (documentation), json (model) or terraform_aws / terraform_azure / terraform_gcp.
